newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures higher, S&Ps spike up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures higher, S&Ps spike up.

text.p: Nov 5 - U.S. stock index futures remained mostly higher, with S&Ps spiking up to fresh intraday highs after U.S. bond futures closed at 1400 CST/2000 GMT. Dec S&Ps rose to 718.35, near the contract high of 718.70, on good dealer buying. Expectations that Republicans will maintain majority control in Congress helped firm the market ahead of U.S. elections results tonight. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
